description: This Java source file defines the class AmqpContextTenantAndAuthIdProvider, which provides methods for extracting tenant and authentication ID information from an AMQP context during SASL handshake processes or message handling. It extends a base class and implements an interface for tenant and auth ID retrieval within an AMQP protocol adapter.

classes.name: AmqpContextTenantAndAuthIdProvider
classes.description: This class provides methods to extract tenant and authentication IDs from an AMQP context, particularly during SASL handshakes, by interfacing with tenant services and examining security context information.
